page.notes: Doubtful readings: "chusan" (first letter-pair is long s or f in the scan; read as plain s). The Greek word after "coena sacra" is not clearly legible and is marked [?]. "coniunctissimi fugiendi si" is marked [?] because the word is blurred. Two entries are read with some doubt: "consensus in religione" (right column, line about "quando fit expectandus") appears to be "confensus" in print, and "conubia" was printed with a looser letter form. The index is set in two columns and nothing is printed in the margins.
